resources.name: DFT-optimized structures of Cu surfaces and CO2RR intermediates (ioChem-BD)

access.notes: Contains VASP POSCAR files of the OD-Cu sites and adsorbed intermediates. The agent must convert coordinates to the chosen DFT code's format.

resources.name: Plane-wave DFT code (e.g., Quantum Espresso, GPAW, ABINIT)

access.notes: Must support PBE exchange-correlation, D2 dispersion correction, PAW pseudopotentials, and implicit solvation (e.g., VASPsol, Environ, or equivalent).
